notes: Algo 8301 "IP Paging Adapter & Scheduler" bridges SIP/VoIP paging to legacy analog amplifiers/PA systems and doubles as a bell/announcement scheduler; PoE-powered, no separate mains power input. A compliance variant, 8301-IC (InformaCast), also exists — spec sheet used here is for the standard 8301. Physical size 6.75 x 4.3 x 1.18 in with a snap mounting bracket (desktop/wall-mount, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted). Line In/Out are each broken out to two parallel connectors (locking mini-XLR and a screw terminal block carrying the same signal) — both listed as separate physical ports since they are distinct connectors on the chassis. Relay In/Out and the terminal-block audio ports are screw/euroblock-style terminals; "euroblock" was used as the closest connector id since a plain terminal-block id is not in the allowed list. Ethernet link speed (10/100 vs Gigabit) was not stated on the fetched product page, so no eth-* grade was set per instructions. Content was retrieved via an AI-summarized page fetch (WebFetch) rather than direct HTML/table parsing, and a direct PDF spec-sheet URL 404'd, so confidence is medium rather than high — recommend a human spot-check against the official downloadable "8301 Spec Sheet" PDF on algosolutions.com if exact figures (e.g., precise relay ratings, Ethernet speed) are critical.

ports.name: Line Out (Mini-XLR)
ports.note: Locking mini-XLR female; balanced/isolated audio to amplifier. Ships with mini-XLR-to-standard-XLR-male cable.

ports.name: Line Out (Terminal Block)
ports.note: Balanced/isolated wire-pair output, parallel signal to the mini-XLR Line Out.

ports.name: Line In (Mini-XLR)
ports.note: Locking mini-XLR male; balanced/isolated page or music input.

ports.name: Line In (Terminal Block)
ports.note: Balanced/isolated wire-pair input, parallel signal to the mini-XLR Line In.

ports.name: Aux In
ports.note: 3.5mm jack, non-isolated analog line-level music input.

ports.name: Aux Out
ports.note: 3.5mm jack, non-isolated output for PC speakers/headset.

ports.name: Relay Input
ports.note: Supervised dry-contact (NO/NC) input; supports Algo 1202/1203 call buttons.

ports.name: Ethernet
ports.note: PoE (IEEE 802.3af Class 0), 48V 15.4W supplied; device draws max 4W, idle 2W. No separate power connector — the unit is powered entirely via this port. Link speed not stated on source page, so no bandwidth grade set.
